en: Jalal al-Din Abu al-Fadl Abd al-Rahman al-Suyuti
ar: جلال الدين أبو الفضل عبد الرحمن السيوطي

description.tr: İslam'ın en verimli yazarı — Kur'ân ilimleri, hadis, dilbilim, tarih ve doğa bilimlerini kapsayan 500+ eser yazdı || Süyûtî, klasik İslam'ın son büyük polimâtı kabul edilir. 500+ eserlik üretimi emsalsizdir. || [Tarih notu] Sartain'ın 1975 çalışması tam bibliyografyayı belgeledi.
description.en: Islam's most prolific author — wrote 500+ works covering Quranic sciences, hadith, linguistics, history, and natural sciences. His al-Itqan remains the definitive encyclopedia of Quranic studies || Suyuti is considered the last great polymath of classical Islam. His output of 500+ works is unmatched. Source material describes him as having written on 'sociology, philosophy of history, and economics' in addition to religious sciences. His Tafsir al-Jalalayn (co-authored) remains one of the most widely used Quran commentaries. || [Historiographical note] Sartain's 1975 study documented the full bibliography. GAS identifies him as the mujaddid (renewer) of the 9th Islamic century. His role as 'last encyclopedist' marks the transition from classical to early modern Islamic scholarship.
description.ar: أغزر مؤلفي الإسلام — كتب أكثر من ٥٠٠ عمل || السيوطي آخر عالم موسوعي عظيم في الإسلام الكلاسيكي. إنتاجه من ٥٠٠+ عمل لا مثيل له. والإتقان لا يزال المرجع الحاسم لعلوم القرآن
